item.title: Understanding Batteries: Sizes, Chemistry, Voltage, Capacity and Lifespan
item.author: hari@dasarpai.com (Dr. Hari Thapliyaal)
item.description:
Understanding Batteries: Sizes, Chemistry, Voltage, Capacity and Lifespan
#

Energy is a current topic, and I wanted to understand batteries. The subject grew as I read, so I wrote a full article. Most of my articles are about data science, quantum computing and advait vedanta. Batteries are a different subject. They are still worth knowing in this much detail.

A battery stores energy chemically and turns it into electrical energy. Labels such as AA, 1.5 V, 2500 mAh, lithium-ion, and rechargeable do not describe the same thing. AA names the size. 1.5 V names the voltage. 2500 mAh names the charge capacity. Lithium-ion names a family of chemistry. Rechargeable means the reaction can run backward in normal use.

Core idea: A battery is not described by one number. Its suitability depends on physical fit, chemistry, voltage, energy, current capability, charging method, life, safety, and cost.
